title: Email & SMS
text: How messages reach your clients: from your own email domain and SMS sender ID, in your brand.
read_only: Only the owner can change these settings.

mail.title: Email
mail.from_now: Emails to your clients come from:
mail.not_allowed: Your account sends from our address under your name. Ask us if you want to use your own domain.
mail.domain_hint: A domain or subdomain you control, e.g. mail.yourcompany.com. Emails will come from no-reply@ this domain.
mail.remove_text: Emails will come from our address under your name again. You would need to publish new records to add it back.
mail.records_text: Add these four TXT records with your DNS provider, then check them. Until all four are right, emails come from our address under your name, so none are lost.

checks.spf: SPF: lets our servers send for you
checks.dmarc: DMARC: tells inboxes what to do with fakes

mail.name: Name

sms.title: SMS
sms.on: SMS is on for your account.
sms.off: SMS is off. Turn on "Send SMS" in your partner rules to send text messages.
sms.hint: 3 to 11 letters, digits or spaces, e.g. ACME ERP.
sms.approval_hint: 3 to 11 letters, digits or spaces. We register it with the operators before it is used; until then, messages use ours.
sms.remove_text: Messages will be sent as ours until you add a new one.
